description: Step 3 («Кому пишем»): three customer profiles (ICP) to search for, from the company and the goal; each with a short title, the profile text and why. The chosen text is the `icp` of create_search. Part of a new search's onboarding: the first assistant call of an onboarding spends one brief (a free account has one search brief and may call each assistant once); pass the returned onboarding_id to the next calls and to create_search. [REST: POST /api/assist/audiences]

onboarding_id.description: The onboarding id that ties the assistant calls and create_search into ONE brief. Omit it on the first call: the answer gives one; pass it to every later assistant call and to create_search of the same new search.

name: suggest_audiences
title: Suggest audiences (onboarding step 3)
